backbone.encoder_weights: randomly initialized from the local pinned RoBERTa configuration via AutoModel.from_config; no pretrained encoder weight loading
backbone.tokenizer: same original pretrained RoBERTa tokenizer/vocabulary as FE/FT; no tokenizer retraining

boundary_policy: The 100-epoch horizon is fixed before results are inspected and is not expanded after validation is seen. If the best epoch is at/near 100 or the curve is still improving there, report that as a limitation/future-work observation.

checkpoint_selection.reason: avoid artificially judging a scratch model only at a potentially overfit final epoch while still using no early stopping
checkpoint_selection.retained_checkpoint: best validation weighted macro-F1; then weighted accuracy; then lower weighted cross-entropy

optimization.hardware_execution: reuse the already-saved HARDWARE_PREFLIGHT.json implementation selected for mathematically equivalent FT execution; actual selected values are recorded in each run record
optimization.mixed_precision: same FP16 encoder autocast + GradScaler behavior as FT; article pooling/head FP32
optimization.optimizer: AdamW; no weight decay on bias/LayerNorm
optimization.scheduler: 10% linear warmup then linear decay over the successful-optimizer-step schedule corresponding to the fixed 100-epoch budget; AMP-skipped steps do not advance the scheduler

purpose: Estimate how the same RoBERTa-base architecture performs on the supervised portal-classification task without pretrained encoder weights. This is a single predefined reasonable scratch-training control, not an exhaustive scratch hyperparameter search.
scope: post-selection random-weight RoBERTa control only; FE/FT selection unchanged
test_policy: Test metadata only for integrity; test article text remains sealed.
